note: Template for the owner's reviewer registry. Copy it to ~/.config/model-mesh/reviewers.json (or point MM_SUPERLOOP_REVIEWERS at it), outside every worktree, and replace each pin with the SHA-256 of the installed file: sha256sum "$(command -v goose)". The goose argv is a sketch: its recipe and --params flags were not checked against a goose install. The driver refuses a reviewer whose pinned files do not match. Pick a goose mode that lets it write the findings file in the review directory; which mode does that was not checked. The review directory is a fresh folder with the diff, never the worktree.
